name: No Left Turn
spec: white square with a black left-turn arrow inside a red circle with a red diagonal slash
meaning: Left turns are not allowed here.

snippets.back: Rectangular regulatory signs control traffic and direct your speed and direction, such as go straight or turn left, no U-turn, no left turn and no right turn.
A red circle with a red slash across a symbol, as on No Left Turn, No Right Turn, No U Turn and No Parking signs, means the action shown is not allowed.
A red circle with a red slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed, such as no left turn or no U-turn.
A No Left Turn sign forbids a left turn at the intersection.
A No Left Turn sign prohibits a left turn at that intersection.
A No Left Turn sign prohibits a left turn.
A red circle with a slash across a turn symbol, as on No Left Turn, No Right Turn and No U Turn signs, means you may not make the turn shown.
A NO LEFT TURN sign forbids a left turn at the signed intersection.

result.summary: Meaning is explicitly supported as forbidding a left turn. Spec describes white square with black arrow plus red circle/slash, but snippets only state red circle with red slash across a symbol and never mention white square or black arrow.
